We appreciate your time. Thank you!

This place is special! Pet centric and very affordable. They love what they do and it shows.
They are always taking such great care of my dog Cooper. You can tell they truly care and want nothing but the best for your pet.
The vetranarians and staff are great with our pups. We have been clients for thirty years.
Great place super nice people
Mercedes 1st visit! She loves you!

Only been there a few times. Fast, friendly, and compassionate service. Thank you for taking such great care of my furry family member! Wish they worked with birds and chickens... but dogs are the priority for me! Prices are fair - and with anything else in life will increase over time. Much better than other places around town.
Great place been going there for years
Great people work here

I had to take Our dog sissy to the vet this morning to get an injection for allergies . Our technician’s name was Tyler. It was a very pleasant visit. He was very informative and even went into detail regarding our breed and the associated allergies for that breed I would highly recommend Moon Valley veterinarian to Address any of your pets needs thank you, Tyler

Beware of unexpected charges! Costs will be discussed initially and seem clear,.. then change after services done with not a good explanation, and they get very defensive if called out and questioned about it..
There's a scam place that took pictures of my cats without permission and yet only charged me $166 for a vet visit.
Nice knowledge people! Respectful also!

So happy that this is the place I chose to bring in my cat when he got an ear hematoma and needed surgery. All of the staff, veterinary techs and doctors are so genuinely caring and professional, and have very great at communication!! Exceeded expectations. Will recommend this place to everyone I know.

The worst place ever. If you love your animal do not take them here. Took my dog in to get a lump removed from his belly. When in operation the office called stating my dogs time was up and they needed more time to remove two more growths on his foot and leg. Pressured my wife to agree then when the operation is done the Vet calls me. She explains to me she was unable to remove all of the tumor in the belly do to it being to large and that it spread to his lymph nodes and in her personal opinion he has 6month to a year left. So it was also in her professional opinion to remove a fatty lipoma from my dogs foot and took to much to properly suture it up. She hopes it will scar together. Big thank you to them for now making the last few months of my pets life miserable for some extra money. Hope that money helps them sleep at night.
Took such good care of our 16 year old baby when she reached the end of her life.
The staff are very friendly and provided excellent care of our pups.
Dr Sabrina takes great care of Jack! The staff is amazing! Clean facilities as well.
Great Vets!.  We have been customers for years.  We have four dogs.

Trying to find a good veterinarian is sometimes a chore. I went to this place 22 years ago and loved it. I really liked the vet.  To my surprise, he was still there! A bit grayer, but the same guy. No, he didn't remember me.  But we still chatted a bit. He was still VERY REASONABLE with his pricing, gave me lots of tips and advice on the care of my Jax.  What I really liked is that he didn't try to sell me all sorts of stuff or an unneeded procedure.  I thought and was sure my dog had a cancerous growth. Nope, he very quickly put my mind at ease!  Thanks, Doc!  I'll be back again for any future visits.  Great service, great doc, great staff, and great price to boot!  Very happy it's still the same after all these years.

Please read:
It started when they refused to give me any advice on how to clean/dress my cats wound unless I upgrade my already completed appointment for I believe about 80-100$. I was coming in for regular tech visits already, and she had over groomed and it was causing her cut to open further. They refused any advice (including telling me that what I was doing was wrong, using neosporin is toxic to cats).
Eventually I found out, fixed it and moved on but later I was directly confronted by an employee for discussing the issue in a different review.
A few months later, after my cat HAD ALREADY RECEIVED HER INJECTION, an employee comes in to tell me her medication has gone up from about 86$ to roughly 119$. I began looking for a new vet but just a month later I called back (from a new number) to confirm these new prices, however they told me the price for a tech visit for Solensia for a cat like mine would be only 93$. BUT AFTER I IDENTIFIED MYSELF by name and phone number, she put me on hold for 5 minutes before returning to tell me that MY price is 119$.
So, in short, they do not care about your animal, and in fact will become vindictive to you and your pet the moment they don't like you or you discuss their short comings.
Fantastic care and facility.

I've been going here for years. I received a call saying i need to come in to follow up on my dogs treatment. While I was making the appointment I made a comment about pricing to the receptionist. I guess it was noted in my chart. She also asked who we normally seen and I said any of the Hatfields. When my husband took our dog in for the appointment Dr. Les asked my husband why he requested him, if he was there to confront him. Dr Les was so unprofessional. Also, the comment i made was about charging to get my dogs blood pressure taken. It was $30. I was just there 10/13 and it's now $45 just get get his blood pressure taken. I will be finding another Vet.
A absolutely amazing first visit. They will be our new vetinarary!!!

In mid-July, we had to make the incredibly difficult decision to say goodbye to our cat after 17 wonderful years. The staff at Moon Valley Animal Hospital was compassionate, supportive, and truly caring throughout the entire process. A couple of weeks later, we received a beautiful thank-you and sympathy card signed by the team, which meant so much to us during a hard time. They truly went above and beyond. A special thank you to Sabrina and Steph for their kindness.

I cannot say enough about the entire staff of Moon Valley. I have taken all four of my dogs and my cat here, and everything from larger procedures to check ups, they are always so friendly amd happy to see us the minute we walk in the door. Dr. Kelly walked us through every step and every option when one of my babies was fighting blood cancer and made a heartbreaking and terrifying journey just a little bit easier. Kayla, Hannah, Amy, Sally and all the techs are just absolutely the best, even when it comes to handling my giant, clumsy great dane who just wants pats and treats and will raid pockets to get it! They are always willing to take time to answer my questions and listen to concerns, I never feel rushed out the door.  THANK YOU for taking such amazing care of all our fur-children!

Dr.Lisa has been my animal's vet of choice since they decided to seek help.  My Dalmatian choose Dr. Lisa right out of vet school.  Dr. Lisa made Sasha feel better regardless of what she did to need care.  Both knees replaced,  reattaching her ear structure, stitches from a poorly designed piece of road curb or a simple ear infection.   Sacha was sweet, affectionate and not at all a Dalmatian; she believed herself a spotted lady.  Dr. Lisa gave her 17  wonderful years of beautiful life.  Along with 3 chinchillas and 2 parrots and a Patagonian.
Now, she oversees the care of my "Hearing ear dog", a 60 pound English Black Lab.   My hearing aid is named COBY, born 10 February,  2020.  His training brought him to me on 28 May, 2022.  Coby likes all the people he's met at MVAH, and we're all hoping for a long series of yearly exams, without incident.

My other vet wasn’t available to get one of my cats in, so I called Moon Valley Animal Hospital and they luckily had an appointment to see her. The front office administrator was very friendly and kind. They got my Adeline back quickly. The assistant and the Veterinarian was very thorough and they helped me feel at ease. They gave excellent service and I would definitely go back if I ever had to. I would also definitely recommend their services to anyone who has a fur baby and wants a Vet that will provide excellent care.

This vet recommended we neuter our 4-5 month old Standard Poodle as first time pet owners because one of his balls didn't drop. We listened to them as professionals.

After the fact, he was really sick and struggled to gain weight and eat foods that were fine before. He is much more anxious than his younger brother (also a poodle) and stuck at about 40-45 lbs with hip issues already compared to his brother who's a year younger, already 60+ and healthy.

DO YOUR RESEARCH AND FACT CHECK (Standard poodles are recommended to get neutered at 12-18 months for fully developed bone and joints, cancer prevention, emotional control and more) 😓

All about the money I guess

Front desk was wonderful. They made the initial appointment process very easy. I took both of my cats in for vaccine updates.

However, they told me my younger cat has gingivostomatitis and the only treatment is to pull out all of her teeth. She's only 3! I wasn't offered to be shown what was wrong with her, just that I had no options and needed to pull her teeth because she's in pain.

I took her for a second opinion this morning at another clinic and the new vet was stumped as to why my baby was diagnosed with such a severe oral condition. I was shown pictures of other cats that have the gingivostomatitis and my kitty had nothing that severe. She DOES have gingivitis, and I was advised to do more at-home care and schedule a cleaning. Much more reasonable than ripping out a young cat's teeth!
They took excellent care of our dog who was extra nervous.

I took my dog Nala to their clinic for a dental evaluation. After her evaluation it was clear she needed teeth extracted. The techs and the veterinarians were very clear on procedure, X-rays, post-op care and answered all of my questions. They were extremely thorough, caring and have an expert touch that left me feeling more than comfortable leaving my fur baby in their care. I would highly recommend this clinic for your pets dental needs. They go above and beyond to ensure your dog is as comfortable and receives top notch care, down to the practice of pre and post op x-rays to ensure everything was extracted properly, doing a nerve block so your pet doesn’t feel pain and even using the best anesthesia. I wouldn’t trust any other doctors with my pet. Thank you to the whole staff. My dog even has a better disposition now. She is more friendly to others and I can tell she is feeling great!
Staff is very friendly, prices are reasonable, they were great with my dog
Great staff they always remember who we are. No problem getting prescriptions refilled, vary caring people.
The doctors Hatfield (Lisa and Les) are kind, caring and competent. I have used other veterinarians and Moon Valley  is the best.
Worst vet I've ever been to.

This hospital did not take proper care of my Chihuahua.  She has always had breathing problems and not once recommended to take lung X-Rays.  Dr. Hatfield and Kelly just said to give my doggie benadryl.  When she went in for her first dental cleaning they did not even call me before they decided to extract all of her teeth (leaving only 2 in) and I feel this was a money grab since extractions are super expensive.  She ended up passing away 3 weeks ago to pneumonia and lots of liquid in her lungs and when I called them to close out my dog's profile they were not compassionate.  All vets I have dealt with in the past have sent condolence cards except for this vet.  Their heart seems only to be in it for the money.

The Hatfields are amazing.  They walked me through a very difficult decision with care. They never judged me , nor made me feel bad about my pets care. They were very compassionate , empathetic, and encouraging . I will never go anywhere else.  RIP Gracie,  we will miss you forever 💔 …
Always professional and compassionate. Very helpful and responsive to questions. They always take amazing care of our daggo thanks to the amazing staff for all you do 🙏❤️ …
